title: HomeCare Program Schedule: Collections and Coverage Periods
content:
Every home Calloway closes is enrolled in the Calloway Limited Home Warranty under one HomeCare program, and the program is set by the purchase collection of the home: the collection named in the program's row below is the collection whose homes are enrolled in that program at closing. Each coverage period is counted from the coverage start date of the home.

## Program by collection

| Program | Collection enrolled at closing |
|---|---|
| HomeCare 1-2-10 Standard | Pathway Collection |
| HomeCare 1-2-10 Select | Meadow Collection |
| HomeCare 1-3-10 Plus | Heritage Collection |
| HomeCare 2-3-10 Preferred | Crestview Collection |
| HomeCare 2-5-10 Premier | Summit Collection |
| HomeCare 2-5-15 Reserve | Reserve Collection |

## Coverage periods (calendar months from the coverage start date)

| Program | Workmanship | Plumbing, electrical and HVAC distribution systems | Structural (load-bearing elements) | Roof leak | Insulated glass seal failure | Yard grading and drainage | Termite pre-treatment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| HomeCare 1-2-10 Standard | 12 | 24 | 120 | 24 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| HomeCare 1-2-10 Select | 12 | 24 | 120 | 36 | 24 | 12 | 12 |
| HomeCare 1-3-10 Plus | 12 | 36 | 120 | 36 | 24 | 12 | 12 |
| HomeCare 2-3-10 Preferred | 24 | 36 | 120 | 48 | 36 | 24 | 24 |
| HomeCare 2-5-10 Premier | 24 | 60 | 120 | 60 | 60 | 24 | 24 |
| HomeCare 2-5-15 Reserve | 24 | 60 | 180 | 60 | 60 | 24 | 36 |

## Appliances and landscaping

| Program | Calendar months during which Calloway handles appliance defects directly | Calendar days of coverage for sod, trees and shrubs installed by Calloway |
|---|---|---|
| HomeCare 1-2-10 Standard | 0 | 30 |
| HomeCare 1-2-10 Select | 0 | 30 |
| HomeCare 1-3-10 Plus | 0 | 60 |
| HomeCare 2-3-10 Preferred | 12 | 60 |
| HomeCare 2-5-10 Premier | 12 | 90 |
| HomeCare 2-5-15 Reserve | 12 | 90 |

After the appliance months have run, appliance defects go to the manufacturer; a program showing 0 appliance months has Calloway handle no appliance defect directly.

## Reading the schedule

- The program's name gives its workmanship, systems and structural years in that order: HomeCare 2-5-10 Premier, for instance, carries 24 months of workmanship, 60 months of systems and 120 months of structural coverage.
- Hypothetical illustration: a home sold in the Heritage Collection is enrolled in HomeCare 1-3-10 Plus, so its roof leak coverage runs 36 calendar months and its landscaping coverage 60 calendar days from the coverage start date.
